title: Domain Admins enumeration not detected on workstation
severityRationale: Discovery precedes privilege escalation; telemetry exists, so the fix is a rule change, not a sensor rollout.
invariant: Domain admin group enumeration from a workstation raises SIEM-DISC-DOMAIN-ADMINS within 600s.
observed: Process telemetry recorded; rule did not fire for lab-win-02. Same rule fired for lab-dc-01 only.
impact: Early-stage discovery on endpoints goes unalerted.
remediation: Extend SIEM-DISC-DOMAIN-ADMINS to endpoint process events (net.exe/net1.exe group /domain).
regressionCheck: Retest S2 in tarosec-purple retest mode; expect Detected.
